C001.text: Hi, can tell me when oat milk is back? Been out for 2 weeks already
Sorry ah! Supplier delay. We'll let you know once it's in
Ok thanks. Also planning my son's birthday party end Oct, you all got party snack packs?

C002.text: My order supposed to come 4pm, now 7pm still nothing
So sorry Marcus, driver got stuck. It's on the way now
Reached already but the frozen dumplings all soft. Not happy leh
Really sorry about that. We'll do better

C003.text: Hello, Deepavali coming, you all bring in ghee and the spice packs again this year?
Yes! Deepavali ghee and spice packs coming in mid Oct
Great, I need a lot, cooking for the whole family

C004.text: Got durian this season or not?
Seasonal durian in stock now, limited boxes
Nice. Also your frozen dumplings which brand ah? My kids like
Our own Kampung Fresh brand, pork and chive

C005.text: Waalaikumsalam, yes sold out, next batch next week
Ok please tell me when come, I only buy those

C006.text: Why your eggs more ex than NTUC ah
Ours are free-range from Malaysia farms, but we hear you
Ok la quality is good. Just delivery fee also quite ex

C007.text: Hi! Office potluck next Friday, you all got party snack packs?
Yes we do, $12 and $20 sizes, can deliver to office
Ok let me check with colleagues how many people first

C008.text: If I order Gardenia bread at 1pm can reach today?
Yes, same-day delivery for orders before 2pm

C009.text: Delivery came 2 hours late and the ice cream melted
We're very sorry Nurul. We'll refund the ice cream
Ok thanks for the refund. Hope next time ok

C010.text: Pokka green tea carton got stock?
Ok I wait. Usually I buy 2 cartons a month

C011.text: Do you deliver to Jurong West?
Sorry, we only deliver within Tampines and Pasir Ris for now

C013.text: Your rice quite ex compared to supermarket
Thanks for the feedback, ours is premium Thai jasmine
I just buy the cheap one la

C014.text: Hi I moved to Woodlands already, can remove me from list?
Noted, thanks for shopping with us all these years!

C015.text: Yes fresh kai lan in this morning

C016.text: Morning! The usual please, 2 loaves Gardenia and kai lan
Morning Hui Min! Will pack for you, ready at 10
Thank you, you all always so fast

C018.text: Is the shop near Tampines MRT?
Yes, 5 min walk from exit B

C019.text: Bought chicken last time not fresh
Very sorry to hear, can we offer a refund?

C020.text: Free delivery for orders above $30 this week

C021.text: Weekly order: rice, eggs, kai lan as usual
Got it Hafiz! Delivering this afternoon

C022.text: The durian last week was very good!
Will come back for more this weekend

C023.text: Can add 2 packs of frozen dumplings to my Saturday order?

C025.text: Your oat milk back yet? I always buy here
Shiok, I'll drop by after work

C026.text: Thanks for packing my order so nicely yesterday

C027.text: Please keep 1 box durian for me, coming Sunday

C028.text: Can I pay by PayNow on delivery?
Great, same order as last week then

C029.text: Morning! Same as usual, eggs, bread, green tea

C030.text: Your kai lan always very fresh, my wife very happy
Thank you Terence! Fresh every morning
